metadata.dcterms:title: A Connection Formula of the Hahn-Exton q-Bessel Function
metadata.dcterms:creator: (2011), SIGMA 7
pages, 11
metadata.dcterms:abstract: We show a connection formula of the Hahn–Exton q-Bessel function around the origin and the infinity. We introduce the q-Borel transformation and the q-Laplace transformation following C. Zhang to obtain the connection formula. We consider the limit p →1−of the connection formula.
